# Minutes / records PR

**Meeting or record:** <!-- e.g., 2026-08-02-weekly -->

## Publication checklist (required)

- [ ] Folder follows `meetings/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>/notes.md` (ADR 0022 convention)
- [ ] No transcript or recording content — the minutes are the record
- [ ] No meeting links, dial-ins, passcodes, or credentials
- [ ] No confidential, privileged, or client-identifying material
- [ ] Attendees, decisions, and action items (with anonymized owners) are present
- [ ] Another attendee or the committee confirmed the attendee list; the reviewer or
      approving body is identified in `notes.md`
- [ ] Statements about identifiable individuals reviewed for accuracy and neutral phrasing
- [ ] Decisions cross-linked to canonical artifacts (ADR / PR / issue) in lq-ai
- [ ] Matching row(s) added to `decisions/README.md`

## Review, approval, and publication

For meeting records, use the [applicable process and transition rule](../meetings/README.md).
For governance/documentation-only PRs, mark meeting-specific checklist items not applicable.

- [ ] Internal circulation, objection deadline, and approval date/basis are separately recorded
- [ ] Applicable seven-day review is complete and objections resolved before publication
- [ ] Material changes were recirculated for a fresh seven-day review; typo fixes need no restart
- [ ] Public discussion and action ownership are anonymized; private review exchanges are excluded
- [ ] GitHub publication is recorded separately after merge; prospective publication does not restart review

Previously published records and records already in review at transition retain the prior
public-posting rule. Preserve historical entries and add dated corrections.
